window.title: WilcoATC Setup
welcome.title: Welcome aboard.
welcome.text: This will install WilcoATC {version}, free voice ATC for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. It takes about a minute and runs entirely on your PC.
welcome.upgrade: WilcoATC is already installed in {path}. This will update it to {version}; your settings and voices are kept.
licence.title: Licence
licence.lead: WilcoATC is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0: use it, share it and change it, as long as what you pass on stays under the same licence. The data it ships with has its own terms, listed in data/navdata/SOURCES.md.
location.title: Where should it go?
location.later: The first launch downloads about {later} more: the voices and the speech recogniser.
opt.start_sub: Find WilcoATC in the Start menu
opt.updates_sub: Only a version check — nothing else is sent
path.relative: Give a full path that starts with a drive letter, such as C:\.
path.invalid: This path has a character Windows does not allow in a folder name.
path.system: WilcoATC cannot go inside the Windows folder.
path.readonly: WilcoATC cannot write here without administrator rights, and it keeps its voices and settings beside itself. Choose a folder in your user profile.
path.too_long: This path is too long for Windows. Choose a shorter one.
path.space: There is not enough free space on this disk.
path.subfolder: This folder already has other files in it, so WilcoATC gets a folder of its own inside it.
path.upgrade: WilcoATC is already here: it will be updated, and your settings and voices kept.
sim.title: Looking for Flight Simulator
sim.note_checking: Checking the usual Steam and Microsoft Store locations…
sim.note_found: WilcoATC connects to Flight Simulator by itself whenever both are running.
sim.note_none: Flight Simulator 2024 was not found. You can install WilcoATC anyway: it connects as soon as the simulator is running.
install.title: Installing WilcoATC
install.phase_data: Installing the airport and frequency data…
err.running: WilcoATC is open. Close it, then press Try again.
err.folder: The folder could not be created.
err.copy: A file could not be written. Check the disk, then press Try again.
err.shortcut: WilcoATC is installed, but a shortcut could not be created.
err.payload: This installer is damaged. Download it again from the releases page.
finish.title: Ready for departure.
finish.text: WilcoATC is installed. The first launch walks you through the downloads, your microphone, your push-to-talk key and SimBrief.
quit.title: Cancel setup?
quit.text: Nothing has been changed on your PC yet. You can run the installer again anytime.
sim.panel_sub: Adds the WilcoATC button to the simulator's toolbar, in {path}
finish.panel_done: The WilcoATC button is in Flight Simulator's toolbar. If the simulator is running, restart it to see it.
err.panel: WilcoATC is installed, but the toolbar panel could not be copied into {path}. Close Flight Simulator and run the installer again.
